name: SVC_CSS_USAGE_AGG
description: This table is used to store the duration of the session when exceeds the predefined session length which will be stored in a profile parameter. USAGE_AGG_ID is primary / unique key in this table.

columns.name: USAGE_AGGREGATE_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Session ID of the request same as in ACTION_CAPTURE.

columns.name: FIRST_ACTION_DATE
columns.description: Derived value from ACTION_CAPTURE table start time of first record for the session.

columns.name: FINAL_ACTION_DATE
columns.description: Derived value from ACTION_CAPTURE table start time of last record for the session.

columns.name: SESSION_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Derived value, use the session level to pick the highest level within a given session.

columns.name: SESSION_USER
columns.description: Derived valued from the ACTION_CAPTURE table, it is the session userderived valued from the ACTION_CAPTURE table , it is the session user.

columns.name: NUM_OF_HITS
columns.description: Sum of number of rows in the ACTION_CAPTURE for the session.

columns.name: LAST_PROCESSED_DATE
columns.description: Indicates the date and time when the record is last processed.
